provenance.sql:
SELECT buyer_inn AS id,buyer_name AS label,count(*) AS deals,sum(amount_uzs) AS amount,sum((CASE WHEN unit='тонна' THEN (quantity)*1000 ELSE (quantity) END)*CAST('0.001' AS DECIMAL(4,3))) AS quantity,
        count(DISTINCT seller_inn) AS distinct_sellers,count(DISTINCT buyer_inn) AS distinct_buyers
        FROM trades WHERE TRUE AND year(deal_date)=? AND deal_date>=? AND deal_date<=? AND commodity=? AND form=? AND status<>? AND grade_norm=? AND unit IN ('килограмм','тонна') GROUP BY buyer_inn,buyer_name
provenance.method: Each requested aggregate uses the same filtered source. Distinct counterparties use COUNT(DISTINCT INN). USD converted at each deal date; kilograms/tonnes converted before aggregation. Exact Decimal ranking and share = group / entire filtered source × 100 before top-N. A zero denominator has no defined share.

operations.title: Brokerlar
operations.sql:
SELECT buyer_inn AS company_inn,buyer_broker AS broker_code,coalesce(b.name,'') AS broker_name,count(*) AS deals,sum((CASE WHEN unit='тонна' THEN (quantity)*1000 ELSE (quantity) END)*CAST('0.001' AS DECIMAL(4,3))) AS quantity,'тонна' AS unit
            FROM trades LEFT JOIN brokers b ON buyer_broker=b.code WHERE TRUE AND year(deal_date)=? AND deal_date>=? AND deal_date<=? AND commodity=? AND form=? AND status<>? AND grade_norm=? AND unit IN ('килограмм','тонна') AND buyer_inn IN (?)
            GROUP BY buyer_inn,buyer_broker,b.name ORDER BY company_inn,quantity DESC,broker_code
